```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 8.5, fig.height = 5.4,
                      dpi = 150, out.width = "100%")
fit <- readRDS(params$fit_file)
is_btl <- inherits(fit, "rasch_btl")
reported_dimensionality <- attr(fit, "report_dimensionality")
reported_subtest <- attr(fit, "report_subtest")
# a refusal is kept so the document says why the dimensionality analysis is
# absent, rather than dropping it without a word
dimensionality_refusal <- NULL
if (is.null(reported_dimensionality)) {
  reported_dimensionality <- tryCatch(
    if (is_btl) btl_dimensionality(fit, seed = 1L)
    else .scree_analysis(
      fit, parallel = !inherits(fit, c("rasch_efrm", "rasch_mfrm")),
      seed = 1L), error = function(e) {
        dimensionality_refusal <<- conditionMessage(e)
        NULL
      })
}
if (!is_btl && is.null(reported_subtest))
  reported_subtest <- tryCatch(dimensionality_test(fit),
                               error = function(e) list(
                                 note = conditionMessage(e),
                                 multidimensional = NA))
reported_invariance <- attr(fit, "report_invariance")
reported_person_weights <- attr(fit, "report_person_weights")
reported_tailored <- attr(fit, "report_tailored")
reported_distractors <- .distractors_or_note(fit)
show_table <- function(x, n = 250L, digits = 3L) {
  if (is.null(x) || !NROW(x)) return(invisible(NULL))
  x <- as.data.frame(x)
  # a silently shortened table reads as the whole analysis: say what was cut
  omitted <- max(0L, nrow(x) - n)
  if (omitted > 0L) x <- x[seq_len(n), , drop = FALSE]
  # probabilities take the package's own vocabulary: rounding to three
  # digits prints an impossible p = 0 for anything below 0.0005
  fmt_p <- function(v, d = 3) {
    lim <- 10^-d
    ifelse(is.finite(v) & v < lim, paste0("< ", format(lim, scientific = FALSE)),
           ifelse(is.finite(v), sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f"), v), ""))
  }
  pcols <- grep("^p$|^p_|_p$|_p_|^p\\.", names(x), value = TRUE)
  for (cn in pcols)
    if (is.numeric(x[[cn]])) x[[cn]] <- fmt_p(x[[cn]])
  labels <- c(
    max_raw = "maximum", theta = "location", fit_resid = "fit residual",
    infit_ms = "infit", outfit_ms = "outfit", p_adj = "adjusted p",
    p_uniform_adj = "uniform p", eta2_uniform = "uniform eta2",
    p_nonuniform_adj = "non-uniform p",
    eta2_nonuniform = "non-uniform eta2", se_log_rho = "SE log(rho)",
    se_log_phi = "SE log(phi)", se_log_alpha = "SE log(alpha)",
    n_responses = "responses", two_delta_loglik = "2 delta logLik",
    p_alpha_adj = "adjusted p (alpha)", p_kappa_adj = "adjusted p (kappa)"
  )
  hit <- intersect(names(labels), names(x))
  names(x)[match(hit, names(x))] <- unname(labels[hit])
  # the note travels as the table's caption: appending it to the kable
  # object would strip its class and render the table as raw text
  cap <- if (omitted > 0L)
    sprintf("First %d rows shown; %d further row(s) omitted.", n, omitted)
  knitr::kable(x, digits = digits, row.names = FALSE, caption = cap)
}
report_columns <- function(x, columns) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
  x[, intersect(columns, names(x)), drop = FALSE]
}
# Text inserted with results='asis' must not become Markdown or raw HTML.
# Tables are escaped by knitr::kable(); this covers headings, notes and other
# prose assembled from uploaded names or fitted-object messages.
report_text <- function(x) {
  x <- enc2utf8(as.character(x))
  # A line break can start a new Markdown block even when every inline marker
  # is escaped (for example, a line containing only hyphens). Headings and
  # prose derived from fitted names therefore stay on one logical line.
  x <- gsub("[\r\n]+", " ", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  marks <- c("\\", "`", "*", "_", "{", "}", "[", "]", "(", ")",
             "#", "+", "!", "|")
  vapply(strsplit(x, "", fixed = TRUE), function(chars)
    paste0(ifelse(chars %in% marks, paste0("\\", chars), chars),
           collapse = ""), character(1))
}
# `what` names the missing display: knitr drops a figure identical to the
# one before it, so two refusals with the same message need distinct text
# to both appear. The message is wrapped to stay inside the figure
safe_plot <- function(expr, what = "Plot") {
  tryCatch(force(expr), error = function(e) {
    plot.new()
    msg <- paste0(what, " unavailable: ", conditionMessage(e))
    text(.5, .5, paste(strwrap(msg, width = 90), collapse = "\n"), cex = .8)
  })
}
```

```{r rasch-results, results='asis'}
if (!is_btl) {
  if (inherits(fit, "rasch_explanatory")) {
    cat("\n# Explanatory model\n\n")
    cat("Formula: ", report_text(fit$explanatory$formula_text), "\n\n",
        sep = "")
    cat("\n## Comparison with free calibration\n\n")
    print(show_table(explanatory_test(fit)))
    cat("\n## Predictor effects\n\n")
    print(show_table(fit$est$coefficients))
    cat("\n## Fixed-departure diagnostics\n\n")
    print(show_table(explanatory_diagnostics(fit)))
    if (nrow(fit$explanatory$relaxations)) {
      cat("\n## Fixed departures\n\n")
      print(show_table(fit$explanatory$relaxations))
    }
  }
  cat("\n# Item estimates\n\n")
  item_tab <- if (inherits(fit, "rasch_mfrm")) fit$item_effects else
    if (inherits(fit, "rasch_efrm")) fit$item_arbitrary else fit$items
  if (.has_repeated_residual_units(fit))
    for (nm in intersect(c("p", "p_adj", "p_bonf", "p_anova",
                           "p_anova_adj", "p_anova_bonf"), names(item_tab)))
      item_tab[[nm]][] <- NA_real_
  if ("p_adj" %in% names(item_tab)) {
    if (.has_repeated_residual_units(fit))
      cat("Item-fit probabilities are withheld because person IDs repeat and the available references assume independent response rows. The fit statistics remain descriptive.\n\n")
    else
      cat("The `p_adj` column is an approximate asymptotic Holm probability. It treats estimated person locations as known; use the bootstrap fit statistics for calibrated inference.\n\n")
  }
  print(show_table(report_columns(item_tab,
    c("item", "max", "location", "se", "fit_resid", "infit_ms",
      "outfit_ms", "p_adj"))))
  cat("\n# Threshold estimates\n\n")
  th <- if (inherits(fit, "rasch_mfrm")) fit$item_thresholds else
    if (inherits(fit, "rasch_efrm")) fit$thresholds_arbitrary else
      fit$thresholds
  if ("delta" %in% names(th) && !"tau" %in% names(th))
    names(th)[names(th) == "delta"] <- "tau"
  if (!is.null(th$item) && is.numeric(th$item)) {
    item_names <- if (inherits(fit, "rasch_efrm")) names(fit$set_of) else
      fit$items$item
    th$item <- item_names[th$item]
  }
  print(show_table(report_columns(th, c("item", "k", "tau", "se"))))
  if (inherits(fit, c("rasch_mfrm", "rasch_efrm"))) {
    cat("\n## Response-cell fit\n\n")
    cat("These rows describe the observed item-by-frame or item-by-facet",
        " cells used in estimation.\n\n")
    print(show_table(report_columns(fit$items,
      c("item", "location", "se", "fit_resid", "infit_ms", "outfit_ms",
        "p_adj"))))
  }
  cat("\n# Targeting and reliability\n\n")
  print(show_table(targeting_table(fit)))
  cat("\n# Unidimensionality t-test\n\n")
  if (!is.null(reported_subtest$note)) {
    cat("Not available: ", report_text(reported_subtest$note), "\n\n",
        sep = "")
  } else {
    resolution_limited <- grepl(
      "resolution insufficient", reported_subtest$verdict_method %||% "",
      fixed = TRUE)
    verdict <- if (isTRUE(reported_subtest$multidimensional))
      "evidence against unidimensionality" else
      if (identical(reported_subtest$multidimensional, FALSE))
        "consistent with unidimensionality" else
          if (resolution_limited)
            "withheld because the bootstrap resolution is insufficient" else
            "withheld for the data-driven split"
    print(show_table(data.frame(
      split = reported_subtest$split,
      significant_percent = 100 * reported_subtest$prop_significant,
      lower_95_percent = 100 * reported_subtest$ci[1],
      upper_95_percent = 100 * reported_subtest$ci[2],
      verdict = verdict,
      bootstrap_p = reported_subtest$p_boot %||% NA_real_,
      bootstrap_resolution = reported_subtest$bootstrap_resolution %||%
        NA_real_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))
    if (is.na(reported_subtest$multidimensional) && resolution_limited) {
      cat(sprintf(paste0(
        "The smallest attainable bootstrap p is %.3f. Increase B for an ",
        "inferential verdict at alpha %.3f.\n\n"),
        reported_subtest$bootstrap_resolution, reported_subtest$alpha))
    } else if (is.na(reported_subtest$multidimensional)) {
      cat("The residual-derived split is descriptive until it is calibrated",
          "by bootstrap or replaced by item subsets fixed in advance.\n\n")
    }
  }
  cat("\n# Person estimates\n\n")
  print(show_table(report_columns(fit$person,
    c("id", "raw", "max_raw", "theta", "se", "extreme", "fit_resid"))))
  if (!is.null(reported_person_weights)) {
    cat("\n# Externally weighted secondary person measures\n\n")
    cat("These measures use the supplied relative item or item-set weights.",
        "They do not replace the ordinary person estimates used elsewhere",
        "in the analysis.\n\n")
    print(show_table(reported_person_weights$table))
    cat("\n## Resolved external weights\n\n")
    print(show_table(attr(reported_person_weights$table, "weighting",
                          exact = TRUE)))
  }
  if (!is.null(reported_tailored)) {
    cat("\n# Tailored analysis for guessing\n\n")
    cat(sprintf(paste0("%d responses with fitted probability below chance ",
                       "%.2f were set to missing. The common origin uses: %s.\n\n"),
                reported_tailored$n_removed, reported_tailored$chance,
                report_text(paste(reported_tailored$anchor_items,
                                  collapse = ", "))))
    if (identical(reported_tailored$se_method, "bootstrap"))
      cat(sprintf(paste0("Person bootstrap: %d of %d replicates usable; ",
                         "probabilities are Holm-adjusted over items.\n\n"),
                  reported_tailored$boot_reps_used,
                  reported_tailored$boot_reps))
    else
      cat("Item shifts are descriptive; no bootstrap uncertainty was requested.\n\n")
    print(show_table(reported_tailored$table))
  }

  if (inherits(fit, "rasch_mfrm")) {
    cat("\n# Facets\n\n")
    for (nm in names(fit$facet_effects)) {
      cat("\n## ", report_text(nm), "\n\n", sep = "")
      print(show_table(report_columns(fit$facet_effects[[nm]],
        c("level", "severity", "se", "n", "fit_resid", "infit_ms",
          "outfit_ms"))))
    }
    if (!is.null(fit$interaction_effects)) {
      cat("\n## Item-by-facet interactions\n\n")
      cat("The omnibus test assesses the complete interaction. Cell rows are",
          " Holm-adjusted follow-ups.\n\n")
      print(show_table(fit$interaction_test))
       print(show_table(report_columns(fit$interaction_effects,
        c("item", "level", "gamma", "se", "t", "df", "z", "p_adj",
          "significant"))))
    }
  }
  if (inherits(fit, "rasch_efrm")) {
    cat("\n# Frame-dependent units\n\n")
    cat("Within-frame thresholds and group units use pairwise conditional",
        " calibration. Item-set units use common persons and a finite-grid",
        " semiparametric link with a separate nuisance distribution for each",
        " observed person group.\n\n")
    cat("\n## Frame model comparison\n\n")
    cat("The likelihood difference describes the group-unit stage. The Wald",
        " tests below provide inference for the group- and set-unit families.\n\n")
    x <- fit$efrm_vs_rasch
    print(show_table(data.frame(
      model = c("Equal group units", "Group-dependent units"),
      loglik = c(x$ll_equal, x$ll_efrm),
      unit_parameters = c(0, x$extra_parameters),
      two_delta_loglik = c(NA, x$two_delta_ll))))
    cat("\n## Omnibus tests of equal units\n\n")
    print(show_table(x$unit_omnibus))
    cat("\n## Unit contrasts\n\n")
    print(show_table(x$unit_tests))
    cat("\n## Frames\n\n")
    print(show_table(report_columns(fit$frames,
      c("set", "group", "rho", "se_log_rho", "origin", "fit_resid",
        "n_responses"))))
    cat("\n## Group units\n\n")
    print(show_table(report_columns(fit$phi_table,
      c("group", "phi", "se_log_phi", "p_adj", "significant"))))
    cat("\n## Item-set units\n\n")
    print(show_table(report_columns(fit$alpha_table,
      c("set", "alpha", "se_log_alpha", "p_adj", "significant"))))
    inv <- if (!is.null(reported_invariance)) reported_invariance else
      tryCatch(frame_invariance(fit), error = function(e) e)
    cat("\n## Item invariance across frames\n\n")
    if (inherits(inv, "error")) {
      cat("Frame invariance was unavailable: ",
          report_text(conditionMessage(inv)), "\n", sep = "")
    } else {
      inv_bootstrap <- identical(inv$se_method, "bootstrap")
      if (inv_bootstrap)
        cat(sprintf(paste0("Whole person rows were resampled within person group, ",
                           "retaining each row's item-set response pattern. Holm ",
                    "adjustment covers %d location and discrimination comparisons. ",
                    "%d of %d refits were usable; %d did not converge ",
                    "and %d otherwise failed.\n\n"),
                    inv$family_n, inv$boot_reps_used, inv$boot_reps,
                    inv$boot_reps_nonconverged, inv$boot_reps_errors))
      else
        cat("The conditional analysis tests", inv$family_n,
            "relative item locations. Its",
            "discrimination columns describe the separate calibrations; use",
            "bootstrap uncertainty for discrimination tests.\n\n")
      print(show_table(inv$summary))
      if (!is.null(inv$excluded) && nrow(inv$excluded)) {
        cat("\n### Excluded comparisons\n\n")
        print(show_table(inv$excluded))
      }
      cat("\n### Location comparisons\n\n")
      print(show_table(report_columns(inv$locations,
        c("set", "frame_1", "frame_2", "item", "difference", "se",
          "statistic", "p_adj", "flagged"))))
      cat(if (inv_bootstrap) "\n### Discrimination comparisons\n\n" else
        "\n### Descriptive discrimination comparisons\n\n")
      disc_cols <- c("set", "frame_1", "frame_2", "item", "infit_1",
        "infit_2", "infit_z", "disc_1", "disc_2", "disc_ratio",
        if (inv_bootstrap) c("se_log_disc_ratio", "statistic", "p_adj",
                            "flagged"), "disc_boundary")
      print(show_table(report_columns(inv$discrimination, disc_cols)))
      nb <- sum(inv$discrimination$disc_boundary %in% TRUE)
      if (inv_bootstrap && nb)
        cat("\n", nb, " discrimination probability/probabilities were withheld",
            " because a fitted slope is on its boundary.\n", sep = "")
    }
  }
  bs <- attr(fit, "report_bootstrap")
  if (!is.null(bs)) {
    cat("\n# Bootstrap fit statistics\n\n")
    cat(sprintf(paste0("Parametric bootstrap null (%s scheme): %d of %d ",
                       "replicates; %d did not converge and %d otherwise ",
                       "failed. Adjustment is separate for each statistic ",
                       "and refers to the fitted global null.\n\n"),
                bs$theta, bs$B_used, bs$B,
                bs$B_nonconverged, bs$B_errors))
    print(show_table(report_columns(bs$items,
      c("item", "chisq", "chisq_p_boot_adj", "n_boot_chisq",
        "fit_resid", "fit_resid_p_boot_adj", "n_boot_fit_resid",
        "infit_z_p_boot_adj", "n_boot_infit_z",
        "outfit_z_p_boot_adj", "n_boot_outfit_z"))))
    if (!is.null(bs$persons)) {
      cat("\n## Person fit\n\n")
      print(show_table(report_columns(bs$persons,
        c("id", "raw", "theta", "fit_resid", "fit_resid_p_boot_adj",
          "n_boot_fit_resid", "infit_ms_p_boot_adj", "outfit_ms_p_boot_adj"))))
    }
  }
  da <- attr(fit, "report_dif")
  if (!is.null(da) || (!is.null(fit$factors) && length(names(fit$factors)))) {
    if (is.null(da))
      da <- tryCatch(dif_anova(fit), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(da)) {
      cat("\n# Differential item functioning\n\n")
      print(show_table(report_columns(da$summary,
        c("item", "term", "p_uniform_adj", "eta2_uniform",
          "p_nonuniform_adj", "eta2_nonuniform", "uniform_DIF",
          "nonuniform_DIF"))))
      if (!is.null(da$sizes) && nrow(da$sizes)) {
        cat("\n## DIF magnitude\n\n")
        print(show_table(report_columns(da$sizes,
          c("item", "term", "level_a", "level_b", "difference", "se",
            "t", "z", "df", "p_adj", "practical"))))
      }
    }
    db <- attr(fit, "report_dif_bootstrap")
    if (!is.null(db)) {
      cat("\n## Bootstrap sensitivity analysis\n\n")
      cat(sprintf(paste0("%d of %d complete-family replicates; %d did not ",
                         "converge and %d otherwise failed. Bootstrap ",
                         "decisions use single-step minimum-p familywise ",
                         "probabilities under the fitted global invariant ",
                         "null; they do not provide strong control when ",
                         "another member has DIF. The adjusted residual ANOVA above ",
                         "remains the primary DIF analysis. Null generator: ",
                         "%s.\n\n"),
                  db$B_used, db$B, db$B_nonconverged, db$B_errors,
                  if (is.null(db$null_method)) "conditional" else
                    db$null_method))
      print(show_table(report_columns(db$summary,
        c("item", "term", "p_uniform_boot_adj", "uniform_DIF_boot",
          "p_nonuniform_boot_adj", "nonuniform_DIF_boot"))))
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(reported_distractors)) {
    cat("\n# Distractor analysis\n\n")
    if (!is.null(reported_distractors$note))
      cat("Not available: ", report_text(reported_distractors$note),
          "\n\n", sep = "")
    else {
      cat("Locations use the rest measure. A distractor chosen by respondents",
          " with higher mean locations than the keyed option's respondents",
          " is flagged as a possible miskey.\n\n")
      print(show_table(reported_distractors$table))
    }
  }
}
```

```{r btl-results, results='asis'}
if (is_btl) {
  if (inherits(fit, "rasch_btl_explanatory")) {
    cat("\n# Explanatory model\n\n")
    cat("Formula: ", report_text(fit$explanatory$formula_text), "\n\n",
        sep = "")
    cat("\n## Comparison with free calibration\n\n")
    print(show_table(explanatory_test(fit)))
    cat("\n## Predictor effects\n\n")
    print(show_table(fit$object_coefficients))
    cat("\n## Fixed-departure diagnostics\n\n")
    print(show_table(explanatory_diagnostics(fit)))
    if (nrow(fit$explanatory$relaxations)) {
      cat("\n## Fixed departures\n\n")
      print(show_table(fit$explanatory$relaxations))
    }
  }
  cat("\n# Object estimates\n\n")
  print(show_table(report_columns(fit$objects,
    c("object", "location", "se", "fit_resid", "infit_ms", "outfit_ms"))))
  cat("\n# Pair fit\n\n")
  print(show_table(report_columns(fit$pairs,
    c("object_a", "object_b", "n", "obs_prop", "exp_prop",
      "obs_mean", "exp_mean", "residual", "chisq"))))
  if (!is.null(fit$judges)) {
    cat("\n# Judge fit\n\n")
    print(show_table(report_columns(fit$judges,
      c("judge", "n", "fit_resid", "infit_ms", "outfit_ms"))))
  }
  bs <- attr(fit, "report_bootstrap")
  if (!is.null(bs)) {
    cat("\n# Bootstrap fit statistics\n\n")
    cat(sprintf(paste0("Fitted-design bootstrap: %d of %d replicates; %d did ",
                       "not converge and %d otherwise failed. Adjustment is ",
                       "separate for each statistic and refers to the fitted ",
                       "global null.\n\n"),
                bs$B_used, bs$B, bs$B_nonconverged, bs$B_errors))
    cat("\n## Whole model\n\n")
    print(show_table(as.data.frame(bs$total)))
    cat("\n## Object fit\n\n")
    print(show_table(report_columns(bs$objects,
      c("object", "fit_resid", "fit_resid_p_boot_adj", "n_boot_fit_resid",
        "infit_ms_p_boot_adj", "outfit_ms_p_boot_adj"))))
    cat("\n## Pair fit\n\n")
    print(show_table(report_columns(bs$pairs,
      c("object_a", "object_b", "n", "residual", "chisq",
        "chisq_p_boot_adj", "n_boot_chisq"))))
    if (!is.null(bs$judges)) {
      cat("\n## Judge fit\n\n")
      print(show_table(report_columns(bs$judges,
        c("judge", "n", "fit_resid", "fit_resid_p_boot_adj",
          "n_boot_fit_resid", "infit_ms_p_boot_adj", "outfit_ms_p_boot_adj"))))
    }
  }
  da <- attr(fit, "report_dif")
  if (!is.null(da)) {
    cat("\n# Differential object functioning\n\n")
    print(show_table(report_columns(da$summary,
      c("object", "term", "p_uniform_adj", "eta2_uniform",
        "p_nonuniform_adj", "eta2_nonuniform", "uniform_DIF",
        "nonuniform_DIF"))))
    if (!is.null(da$sizes)) {
      cat("\n## DIF magnitude\n\n")
      print(show_table(report_columns(da$sizes,
        c("object", "term", "level_a", "level_b", "difference", "se",
          "t", "z", "df", "p_adj", "practical"))))
    }
  }
  db <- attr(fit, "report_dif_bootstrap")
  if (!is.null(db)) {
    cat("\n## Bootstrap sensitivity analysis\n\n")
    cat(sprintf(paste0(
      "%d of %d complete-family replicates; %d did not converge and %d ",
      "otherwise failed. The null generator was %s. Bootstrap decisions ",
      "use single-step minimum-p familywise probabilities under the fitted ",
      "global invariant null; they do not provide strong control when another ",
      "member has DIF. The adjusted ",
      "residual ANOVA remains primary.\n\n"),
      db$B_used, db$B, db$B_nonconverged, db$B_errors,
      if (is.null(db$null_method)) "fitted-outcome" else db$null_method))
    print(show_table(report_columns(db$summary,
      c("object", "term", "p_uniform_boot_adj", "uniform_DIF_boot",
        "p_nonuniform_boot_adj", "nonuniform_DIF_boot"))))
  }
  if (inherits(fit, "rasch_btl_efrm")) {
    cat("\n# Frame-dependent units\n\n")
    cat("Within-set comparisons estimate object locations and panel units.",
        " Cross-set comparisons then estimate set units and origins directly;",
        " no person distribution is used.\n\n")
    cat("\n## Frame model comparison\n\n")
    if (identical(fit$se_method, "conditional"))
      cat("The likelihood difference is descriptive. Unit probabilities are",
          " withheld because conditional errors omit first-stage",
          " uncertainty.\n\n")
    else
      cat("The likelihood difference is descriptive. The Wald tests below",
          " provide inference for the unit families.\n\n")
    x <- fit$equal_unit
    print(show_table(data.frame(
      model = c("Equal units", "Frame-dependent units"),
      loglik = c(x$loglik_single, x$loglik_frames),
      parameters = c(x$parameters_single, x$parameters_frames),
      two_delta_loglik = c(NA, x$two_delta_ll))))
    cat("\n## Omnibus tests of equal units\n\n")
    print(show_table(fit$unit_omnibus))
    cat("\n## Panel units\n\n")
    print(show_table(report_columns(fit$phi_table,
      c("panel", "phi", "se_log_phi", "p_adj", "significant"))))
    cat("\n## Set units and origins\n\n")
    au <- merge(
      fit$alpha_table[, c("set", "alpha", "se_log_alpha", "p_adj")],
      fit$kappa_table[, c("set", "kappa", "se_kappa", "p_adj")],
      by = "set", sort = FALSE)
    names(au)[names(au) == "p_adj.x"] <- "p_alpha_adj"
    names(au)[names(au) == "p_adj.y"] <- "p_kappa_adj"
    print(show_table(au))
    cat("\n## Frame fit\n\n")
    print(show_table(report_columns(fit$frames,
      c("set", "panel", "rho", "kappa", "fit_resid", "n"))))
  }
  tr <- tryCatch(btl_transitivity(fit), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(tr)) {
    cat("\n# Transitivity\n\n")
    print(show_table(tr$summary))
  }
  if (!is.null(reported_dimensionality)) {
    cat("\n# Residual dimensionality\n\n")
    print(show_table(reported_dimensionality$bimensions))
  } else if (!is.null(dimensionality_refusal)) {
    cat("\n# Residual dimensionality\n\n")
    cat("Not available: ", report_text(dimensionality_refusal), "\n\n",
        sep = "")
  }
}
```

# Diagnostic figures

```{r rasch-plots, fig.show='hold'}
if (!is_btl) {
  safe_plot(plot_pimap(fit))
  safe_plot(plot_tif(fit))
  safe_plot(plot_item_map(fit))
  safe_plot(plot_person_fit(fit))
  safe_plot(plot_resid_cor(fit))
  safe_plot(plot_pca(fit))
  if (!is.null(reported_dimensionality))
    safe_plot(plot_scree(fit, result = reported_dimensionality))
  else if (!is.null(dimensionality_refusal))
    safe_plot(stop(dimensionality_refusal), what = "Scree plot")
  if (inherits(fit, "rasch_efrm")) {
    safe_plot(plot_icc_frames(fit, unique(fit$virtual_map$item)[1]))
    safe_plot(plot_frames(fit))
  } else {
    safe_plot(plot_icc(fit, fit$items$item[1]))
  }
  if (inherits(fit, "rasch_mfrm") && length(fit$facet_spec))
    safe_plot(plot_facets(fit, fit$facet_spec[1]))
}
```

```{r btl-plots, fig.show='hold'}
if (is_btl) {
  safe_plot(plot_btl(fit))
  safe_plot(plot_btl_targeting(fit))
  safe_plot(plot_btl_icc(fit, fit$objects$object[1]))
  tr <- tryCatch(btl_transitivity(fit), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(tr)) safe_plot(plot_btl_transitivity(tr, by = "object"))
  if (!is.null(reported_dimensionality)) {
    safe_plot(plot_btl_scree(reported_dimensionality))
    safe_plot(plot_btl_dim_map(reported_dimensionality))
  } else if (!is.null(dimensionality_refusal)) {
    safe_plot(stop(dimensionality_refusal), what = "Dimensionality plots")
  }
  if (inherits(fit, "rasch_btl_efrm")) safe_plot(plot_btl_units(fit))
}
```
